about: SSO's five string sections' All techniques patches: Long and the techniques measured on velocity or both (the map's played ones), 2026-10-12 (branch long-calibration; tools/soundlibraries/string_dynamics_sweep.py has the method). Windows test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8 (VST 3; MuseScore's resaved setups, library defaults), offline through kthost, 44.1 kHz. At the check's pitch, with the check's measures and note lengths, each point played 4 times in a row, CC1 1.0 s before the note-on: 'curve' the loudest 50 ms, 'perceived' the perceived loudness peak, each the median of the repeats ('spread': their max - min); 'drivenBy', 'velocityDb', 'controllerDb' as the check (medians); Long's 'expression' (CC11 at velocity = CC1 = 80; 127: the curve's 80) and 'replay' (Long played as the check does: CC1 0.1 s before, the check's order of points, two passes; each value). checks: the loudest 0.3 s before a note-on, the latest audio start after a note-on, notes without sound. calibration_from_sound_dynamics.py -s puts the entries into the shipped dynamics.json in place of sso_sound_dynamics.json's.
